text.description_html:
Fusion RH-A6, Bronze River Rock Bathroom Robe Hook

When it comes to traditional style, Fusion Hardware is not easily out-staged. They have a firm grasp on what traditional hardware is in essence: beautiful shapes, classic finishes, and designs that are both arresting and have a sense of timelessness. The Bronze River Rock Rope Hook with Round Mount is all of this. Easy to install, it comes with all the necessary mounting hardware. Choose from either medium bronze or dark bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion PH-A6 Bronze River Rock Toilet Paper Holder, Fusion TB-A6 Bronze River Rock Towel Bar, and Fusion TR-A6 Bronze River Rock Towel Ring

Features and Specifications of the Fusion River Rock Series Bronze Round Radius Robe Hook:

  • Mount Diameter: 3"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
